title: Aligning with Lived Experience: Heterogeneous Benefits of Fine Tuning in Mental Health Support Generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.21075v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As access to professional mental healthcare remains limited, many individuals turn to online platforms such as Reddit to seek peer support situated within human lived experience. However, a significant portion of such queries go unanswered, presenting an opportunity for using Large Language Models (LLMs) to fill this gap. While LLMs have demonstrated strong performance on clinical benchmarks, their ability to generate lived-experience informed and community-aligned peer support is underexplored. Addressing this gap, we introduce the COmmunity-centered Peer Engaged Support (COPES) dataset and a three-axis evaluation framework to assess LLM alignment with community perspectives to mental health support seeking queries. Evaluating zero-shot and post-trained (SFT and DPO) models, we show that post-training on COPES significantly improves Strategy Alignment (>50% for general-purpose models) and alignment in Emotion & Tone. translated_title: 与生活经验对齐：心理健康支持生成中微调的异质性收益
translated_abstract: 随着专业心理健康医疗服务的获取仍然有限，许多人转向Reddit等在线平台，寻求植根于人类真实生活经验的同伴支持。然而，这类求助中有相当大一部分未得到回应，这为利用大语言模型（LLM）填补这一空白提供了机会。尽管LLM在临床基准测试中已展现出强大性能，但其生成基于生活经验、符合社区规范的同伴支持的能力尚未得到充分探索。为填补这一空白，我们引入了以社区为中心的同伴参与支持数据集，以及一个三轴评估框架，用于评估LLM与社区对心理健康求助问题的观点之间的对齐程度。通过评估零样本和后训练（SFT和DPO）模型，我们表明在COPES上进行后训练显著提升了策略对齐度（通用模型超过50%）以及情感与语气方面的对齐度。然而，我们也……
tldr: 该论文提出了COPES社区中心同伴支持数据集和三轴评估框架，发现在该数据集上进行后训练（SFT和DPO）能显著提升大语言模型生成符合社区生活经验的心理健康同伴支持的能力，且微调对不同类型模型的收益存在异质性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the COPES dataset and a three-axis evaluation framework, showing that post-training (SFT and DPO) on COPES significantly improves LLMs' ability to generate community-aligned mental health peer support, with heterogeneous benefits of fine-tuning across different models.
